```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
repo_root <- normalizePath(".")
if (!file.exists(file.path(repo_root, "README.md"))) {
  stop("Render this report with scripts/render_reproduction_report.R from the repository root.")
}
setwd(repo_root)

embed_pdf <- function(path, height = "650px") {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Expected figure was not created: ", path)
  knitr::asis_output(sprintf(
    '<object data="%s" type="application/pdf" width="100%%" height="%s">\n<a href="%s">Open figure PDF</a>\n</object>',
    path, height, path
  ))
}
```

# Purpose

This literate report recreates and displays the manuscript simulation figures
from the archived, replication-ready CSV files in `results/`. Each code chunk
calls the same figure script used for the manuscript. Consequently, compiling
this document does not require rerunning the full Monte Carlo simulations.

The canonical mapping to the uploaded manuscript and supplementary-material
figure numbers is in [`docs/FIGURE_MAP.md`](docs/FIGURE_MAP.md). The
restricted-data application figures (main Figure 6 and supplementary Figures
S9–S11) are not run by this public report.

# Canonical manuscript and supplementary figures

```{r canonical-figures}
canonical_scripts <- c(
  sprintf("scripts/manuscript_figure_%d.R", 1:5),
  sprintf("scripts/supplementary_figure_%d.R", 1:8)
)
invisible(lapply(canonical_scripts, source, chdir = FALSE))
```

```{r show-canonical-figures, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
canonical_figures <- c(
  sprintf("figures/generated/manuscript_figure_%d.pdf", 1:5),
  sprintf("figures/generated/supplementary_figure_%d.pdf", 1:8)
)
for (figure in canonical_figures) {
  cat("\n## ", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(figure)), "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(embed_pdf(figure), "\n\n")
}
```

The exact data-generating models are in
[`docs/SIMULATION_MODELS.md`](docs/SIMULATION_MODELS.md). To rerun the
Monte Carlo experiments themselves, use the numbered scripts documented in
[`docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md`](docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md).

# Output

The regenerated PDFs and their underlying summary CSV files are in
`figures/generated/`. This report is a convenient visual audit trail; the
standalone scripts remain the primary figure-reproduction entry points.
